WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT sf.zoneref, s.entrystat, sf.traitcount
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
  JOIN sites AS s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sf.traitcount > 489
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       entrystat AS access_status,
       avg_traitcount,
       record_count,
       record_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS record_share
FROM grouped
ORDER BY record_share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
